title: Numbers and time
summary: Count from zero to the millions, keep nouns singular after numbers, tell the time with *buçuk*, *çeyrek*, *geçe* and *kala*, and give dates, ages and prices.
canDo: Count, and say how many of something there are
Ask and tell the time, and say when something happens
Name the days and months and give a date
Ask how old someone is and how much something costs
